skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Honor and Splendor
skins.content: 0011 New Arrivals/Honor and Splendor. Handcrafted by Lungmen artisans, this outfit synergizes a wide variety of practical fabrics, providing a truly holistic look to meet exacting demands while still maintaining an affordable price.
skins.usage: The dress Swire wore to a Spring Festival L.G.D. event.
skins.quote: Blink and you'll miss it. You'll never forget it when you see it.
